messages:
alex_k: opened PR https://git.internal/redwood/runtime/pull/2345 — small kernel tweak to KV prefetch + batch window to avoid occasional head-of-line stalls. Can someone take a quick look? Hoping to merge during today’s short merge window.

maya: on it, tagging perf owners @nate :eyes: 

nate: looking now. quick Q — did you move the batch cutoff config? I don't see batch_cutoff_ms in the top-level config anymore.

alex_k: good catch. moved it into runtime/heuristics.py to make it per-model. snippet:```diff
+ # heuristics.py
+ batch_cutoff_ms = 8  # ms (was 10)
```

rachel: reading tests — can you add a tiny unit for the small-batch fallback path? coverage there is flaky and the change touches the edge case.

alex_k: added test and pushed another commit (force-pushed minor rename). CI should rerun shortly — cc @ci-bot

ci-bot: Build passed — all checks green (runner: linux-x86-aws-12) ✅

maya: left two tiny comments about a var name and docstring. otherwise :+1:

nate: ran a quick perf on my machine — 95p tail latency down ~3% for mix-traffic. looks safe to me.

alex_k: thanks. plan is merge in ~35m unless anyone objects — I'll watch dashboards and can roll back if the 95p spikes.

rachel: ok from me, thanks for adding the test.

maya: LGTM once the two nits are addressed.

alex_k: merged. monitoring now. will open a rollback if anything odd shows up. thanks everyone :rocket:
